cells.gaps: No source found says other operators buy capacity at the landing station or on the cable, or that it runs on open-access or wholesale terms; the NCA's 2024 authorisation template (GHA-009) permits a sale and names no holder.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-10: CSquared (July 2026) and a 2024 Ghanaian Times piece say Ghana reaches Equiano by land from Lome beside the cables landing at Accra, so a cable and a land route share no landing station (GHA-011, GHA-012), and 2Africa landed at Accra in 2025 (GHA-004). No sale of capacity to other operators is stated, so not 5.
